name: 04-python-fizzbuzz
prompt: Write fizzbuzz.py: given a number N as its only argument it prints FizzBuzz for 1..N, one per line (Fizz for multiples of 3, Buzz for 5, FizzBuzz for both, the number otherwise).
check: test "$(python3 fizzbuzz.py 15 | tail -1)" = "FizzBuzz" && test "$(python3 fizzbuzz.py 15 | sed -n 3p)" = "Fizz" && test "$(python3 fizzbuzz.py 15 | wc -l)" = "15"
